_how: One line per niche. The home page marks a niche LIVE when data_url answers with JSON whose 'updated' date is at most 14 days old. To add a niche: publish an index JSON with an 'updated' field (YYYY-MM-DD; if on another subdomain, send Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *) and fill url + data_url here.
